Introduction

must be performed for fuel oil injection pump skid as indicated M6 in the above 
titled block

Technical Specifications
Manufacturer | Sluzer-Weise. |  | Quantity | 56.3 69.1 m3 / hr.
Liquid handled | Fuel oil. |  | Motor speed | 2980 R.P.M.
Viscosity | 11 15 mm2 / sec. |  | Motor power | 250 kw.
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area,
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Wear 
 safety helmets, shoes, earplug and gloves pairs.
Isolate 
 the pump mechanically and electrically.
Tools and Equipment
Compressed air hose.
Maintenance tool set.
Oil container, Refill oil pump.
Drain all the old oil from the reservoir.
Fill 
 the reservoir with the same type of oil and put it back into standard
 position [2/3 
 of the reservoir minimum].
